# The repair cafe doesn't need its founder every time

Rafi and Lena ran the repair cafe while I was away. They changed the intake layout and explained why in a note. Good. [[Repair ideas]] should let a practice evolve without my approval of every detail. The waiting time was recorded by visitors rather than estimated afterwards from the rota.
